context_for_next_testing_agent: The sticking-after-drag regression fix has been applied (cancelAnimation in onStart worklet). Web Playwright testing confirms: 5/5 consecutive drags to invalid targets work without sticking. Tutorial flow (bubble → soup fly → inspect bubble → draggable state) works correctly at all tested viewports. Tap gesture and consume drag were NOT testable via Playwright (requires touch context). These must be verified on Expo Go / physical device.
rca_of_issue: Root cause was cancelAnimation called from JS thread (runOnJS in onDragBegin) instead of UI thread worklet. On native Expo Go, this caused race condition where in-flight return animations were not reliably cancelled before new drag began, making soup 'stick'. Fix: moved cancelAnimation calls to panGesture.onStart worklet (runs on UI thread synchronously). Secondary fix: onFinalize now checks success parameter to only clean up on cancelled gestures (success=false), preventing race with normal onEnd handling.
